scientific_integrity: Complete analytic argument given for strict finite balancing and the fixed-population local-limit asymptotic. Finite exact tests supplement, but do not replace, the infinite proof; no independent validation is claimed. Publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Common iid Bernoulli realizations across goods, shared identically by agents; fixed deterministic pre-realization allocations; not heterogeneous item probabilities, independent agent-good random values, arbitrary lotteries, or population-uniform limits.
title: Strict balancing and polynomial decay of realized EF1 for shared Bernoulli lottery goods
